# Filtered dictionary entries

Generated by `node scripts/dictionaries/update.mjs`. Every row identifies its upstream location; one regex may expand into many separately filtered literals. Counts here are expanded matchers, not raw upstream rows. Exact duplicates merged into a surviving vendor rule are recorded in report.json, not counted as false-positive drops.

No unlicensed or copyleft dictionary was copied. Rules are conservative: single words need measured r>=5 and projected pre-LLM abstract prevalence <=0.1%; sampler suppression is not measured lift. Ordinary professional words, human corpus hits, career announcements, fiction/topic strings, conditional riders and context-free rhythm/grammar rules are excluded. See README.md for rationale and limitations.
